english:
Reaching Critical Health while at 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge with no Resist buffs active grants <pve 10% /> <pvp [2.5%] /> Damage Resist (Resist x1).

Duration is based on the amount of Armor Charges consumed: 6|9|12|15 seconds.

source.text:
Upon reaching Critical Health while at x3 or more Armor Charges while no Resist Bufs are active:

10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1).
Duration is based on the amount of Armor Charges consumed.

Buff Duration at x3, x4, and x5 Charges.
6 | 9 | 12 | 15 seconds.
